$comment: Index grouping for the skills.sh ecosystem.  Auto-indexers crawl skills/*/SKILL.md in a public repository.  Each entry below groups one skill on a single page.

skills.name: elohim
skills.description: Checksum-pinned numerical-instrument gate: 16 pinned facts, 6 independent trap re-derivations, a source hygiene lint, and a proven tamper test.

skills.name: elohim-harness
skills.description: The shared gate, not a fact-pinning skill. It holds no ledger and no instrument of its own and has 0 pinned facts and 0 traps to report. It runs the pin, fact, trap and hygiene gates against any skill directory named by --skill-dir, so the other five entries in this index each need no gate code of their own. Every count in every other entry was measured by this harness.

skills.name: estimator-bias
skills.description: 15 pinned facts, 7 independent trap re-derivations. Deflates a cubic to prove a Pisot decay rate exactly, fits the same rate from the data, and reports the gap over four ranges in units of the fit's own standard error.

skills.name: invariant-hunter
skills.description: 3 pinned facts, 5 independent trap re-derivations. An honest negative: it measures a claimed Collatz conserved quantity and a derived ghost seed and returns the measurement that shows neither is structure.

skills.name: precision-budget
skills.description: 9 pinned facts, 6 independent trap re-derivations. Derives the working-digit budget for a Pisot bound from the formula, then measures whether it is sufficient and shows the same quantity collapsing on a starved budget.

skills.name: tolerance-prover
skills.description: 23 pinned facts, 7 independent trap re-derivations. Measures the tightness of the Pisot bound 2 for the tribonacci and plastic constants and establishes that it is a supremum no finite n attains.
